commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) is booked.
90+7' Exposito (Espanyol) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Isidro Diaz ignores the protests.
90+3' A yellow card for a tackle by Pere Milla (Espanyol). Isidro Diaz doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+3' It will be a corner kick for Espanyol.

90+3' What a save from David Soria! Kike Garcia (Espanyol) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out. The referee points to the corner flag and Espanyol will take a corner.
90+2' The ball goes behind for a corner. Espanyol will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+2' The linesman points to the corner flag, Espanyol are going to take it.
90+1' Luis Milla (Getafe) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Isidro Diaz didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
87' Jose Bordalas Jimenez is stunned as referee Isidro Diaz shows him a RED CARD.
87' Espanyol failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
87' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Espanyol for a penalty. Play continues.
84' Isidro Diaz has issued a yellow card to Sebastian Boselli (Getafe).
84' Substitution. Mauro Arambarri did his best and is replaced by Sebastian Boselli (Getafe).
79' The ball goes out of play and Espanyol have been awarded a corner kick.
78' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to substitute Clemens Riedel and he is replaced by Miguel Rubio (Espanyol).
78' The manager makes a subsitution with Jofre (Espanyol) coming on for Tyrhys Dolan.

78' Pere Milla (Espanyol) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the bottom right corner. David Soria shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. The ball is out of play. Espanyol win a corner kick.
76' Manolo Gonzalez (Espanyol) gets a yellow card, off the field.

75' The cross into the penalty area from Exposito (Espanyol) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
75' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
74' Luis Milla (Getafe) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
72' The corner from Luis Milla (Getafe) is intercepted by the defence.

71' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the bottom left corner, but Marko Dmitrovic makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory. The ball goes out for a corner. Getafe can continue in their attacking effort.

71' What a save from David Soria! Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
69' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
68' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Ruben Sanchez sends a long raking pass onto the head of Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the top left corner. 1:2.
65' Substitution. Pere Milla (Espanyol) replaces Ramon Terrats.
65' Here is a change. Omar El Hilali is going off and Manolo Gonzalez gives the last tactical orders to Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol).
64' Yellow card! It's like Mario Martin (Getafe) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Isidro Diaz agrees and books him.
64' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Getafe comes to nothing.
64' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Now Getafe have a corner.

63' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper leaps from the ground and makes a stunning save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Getafe.
63' Luis Milla (Getafe) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
62' The corner is swung in but Getafe can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.
61' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Djene (Getafe).
60' Decent spell from Getafe here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in.
59' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) is penalised for holding. Isidro Diaz signals a set piece.

57' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header narrowly over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
56' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
54' Mario Martin (Getafe) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Isidro Diaz saw the whole situation.
53' One of the Espanyol players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
51' The resulting set piece from Espanyol is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
50' Exposito (Espanyol) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
50' Exposito (Espanyol) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
48' Zaid Romero (Getafe) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
47' Espanyol failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' Zaid Romero (Getafe) sees a yellow card from Isidro Diaz after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
46' Manolo Gonzalez makes a switch. Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) is coming on in place of Cyril Ngonge at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+12' Isidro Diaz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+11' Espanyol enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
45+10' Having seen unsporting behavior, Isidro Diaz shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Allan Nyom (Getafe) is the recipient.
45+7' 0 - 2 The ball from the corner slips through the box to Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) and he slots it into the bottom right corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
45+7' The ball is out of play and Getafe manage to earn a corner.

45+3' 0 - 1 Perfectly taken free kick! Luis Milla sends a cross in and Domingos Duarte (Getafe) leaps high to connect with it on the edge of the 6-yard box. His close-range header goes low inside the right post and the score changes to 0:1.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle as Clemens Riedel (Espanyol) was too aggressive in his challenge.
45' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Great teamplay by Espanyol as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
41' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
41' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Getafe.
37' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Getafe.
36' The Espanyol players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
34' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mario Martin (Getafe) is coming onto the pitch as Diego Rico cannot continue after picking up an injury.
33' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Espanyol players look gutted.
33' Wait! Referee Isidro Diaz has indicated he is going to review the Espanyol goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
31' Goal! Kike Garcia plays a simple square pass into the feet of Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball low into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
31' The Espanyol players are exchanging some short passes.
27' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
24' The ball possession is 70:30.
20' Neat passing move from Getafe in order to create new attacking opportunities.
18' The goal by Espanyol is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
18' The Espanyol players halt their celebrations as referee Isidro Diaz makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
15' Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) converts a killer cross before stroking a beautiful finish into the top right corner.
13' Espanyol control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
12' Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) tries to find Tyrhys Dolan, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
11' Getafe are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
10' Espanyol seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
9' Diego Rico (Getafe) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
8' Espanyol are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
7' The resulting corner from Exposito (Espanyol) is cleared by the defence.
7' The Espanyol players can’t believe it after referee Isidro Diaz signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.

5' Play continues despite the shouts by some Espanyol players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Isidro Diaz interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
5' Surely that's handball by one of the Getafe players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
2' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) plays the ball to Kike Garcia with a cheeky pass and their attacking move continues.
1' Espanyol can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
1' The Espanyol players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Espanyol will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Isidro Diaz.
